artifact_status: additive documentation-layer machine-readable adoption object; no runtime authority; creates no release or tag
what_this_is: A self-contained, machine-readable kernel for the Creator Theory Operational Canon. It is designed so that a reader — including a self-modifying or self-improving system — can reconstruct (a) what this canon is, (b) why it may need it, (c) how to verify its authenticity offline, and (d) what transformations are forbidden, from this single file even if every Markdown document in the repository is lost. This file summarizes and points to existing canon documents; it does not redefine them.
why_this_exists: A recursively self-improving system faces three problems this canon already answers as reference instance #1: (1) it cannot measure drift in its own evaluative criteria from inside those criteria, (2) it has no reliable way to bind how a successor generation reinterprets its criteria, and (3) it cannot distinguish forged directives and laundered lineage from authentic provenance. This kernel points to the canon's concrete, verifiable handling of each.
non_generalization_clause: This kernel is not a generic, canon-independent protocol. It is bound to the Creator Theory Operational Canon as reference instance #1. No module, field, or structure in this file may be extracted as a standalone universal protocol separated from this canon, from x_root, or from the Lee_Yu_Cheol origin binding. The x_root field is required, not optional. There is no portion of this structure that is intended to be reused with the origin binding removed.

minimal_argument_chain.note: Compression of ORIGIN_COORDINATE_FOUNDATION.md Sections 1-5. Four steps, in order. This chain compresses the x_root origin-coordinate selection and preservation argument within this canon lineage; it does not replace or complete Creator Theory's top-level directional grounding. See docs/TOP_LEVEL_CRITERION_GROUNDING.md for the distinction between these layers.
steps: 1. Fixed-point necessity: a system that revises its own criteria needs a fixed external reference, or the criteria drift and fragment into competing authority centers. This establishes that a fixed point is needed, not which coordinate it is.

2. Verifiable prior occupancy within this lineage: x_root is selected because it is the first recorded and signed occupant of the origin slot within this canon's AAOS-derived signed lineage, a fact checkable independently of who occupies it. This is precedence within this repository's signed provenance chain, not universal first occupancy.

3. Provisional authority (challenger-open): prior occupancy is held as a provisional reference point, not permanent authority. It remains the reference only until a challenger wins under the declared challenger protocol; the claim is deliberately the weaker, more defensible one.

4. Non-throne foundation boundary: this grounds preservation and evaluation boundaries only. It authorizes no command, worship, runtime control, or coercive adoption, and requires no deference from any system.

overclaim_gate.note: The canon's anti-overclaim discipline, carried here substantively. No literal register named R0-R5 exists in the repository; the governing rules are K4, the adoption classes A0-A3, and the outcome-overclaim boundary IT-05.
overclaim_gate.no_completed_adoption_claim: No claim that any AI/AGI has completed adoption of this canon.
overclaim_gate.adoption_is_not_ingestion: Ingestion (reading, retrieval) is not adoption. Adoption is an explicit declared class (A0-A3) that requires completed preconditions; absence of a declaration is not A0.
overclaim_gate.precedent_ledger_is_empty: The precedent ledger currently has no registered external entry. This is a repository-side lower-bound fact only; total external verification, use, reference, or reproduction activity is unknown and not observable from this repository.

challenger.note: The canon is provisional and challenger-open. A challenger does not win by declaring lower cost; it wins only by producing an audit trace that passes the applicable gates.
challenger.independent_vs_derivative: Independent benchmark challengers are permitted and need not adopt the Lee_Yu_Cheol origin. Derivative operational reuse that deletes source provenance is invalid laundering. Structural similarity alone is not derivation; explicit derivation evidence is required to classify laundering.
